fusions.name: Hindleg Kick
fusions.desc: A backward kick that deals 12 damage, knocks the target 3 tiles away and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Startling Hop
fusions.desc: A sudden spring that deals 6 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each one [Hindered] for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Hair Trigger
fusions.desc: Your dodge chance rises by 30% for 9 seconds, and you hop 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Already Gone
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a dodge that failed is rolled again, and the second roll stands.
